**Verdict: don't publish yet. One claim has to go.**

**Claims check**

| Claim in draft | Status |
|---|---|
| "New tins just landed for winter" | OK. New product arrivals are a product-team fact. |
| "made with zero waste from farm to cup" | **Unsupported.** "Zero waste" is on the never-make list (section 3), and nothing in section 2 backs it. |
| "Deep green, gold lettering" | OK. Product fact. |
| "the same plastic-free tea bags inside" | OK. Allowlisted. |
| "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" | OK. Allowlisted, exact wording (EN 13432 certificate). |

**Other checks**
- **Disclosure:** none needed. This is our own account, and the platform marks paid ads.
- **Banned words and voice:** no hits. Spelling is UK and the tone is plain.
- **Urgency, health claims, superlatives, stats:** none.
- **Redundancy (optional):** "plastic-free" appears twice in three sentences, so the last sentence repeats the second. Merging them reads more unhurried.

**Suggested replacement**

> New tins just landed for winter. Deep green with gold lettering, and the same plastic-free, home compostable tea bags inside.

This drops "zero waste" and keeps the allowlisted bag claim in one place. If you want a farm-to-cup line, send me a specific, sourced fact, such as where a tea is grown or when it's picked. Those are fine to use. Sam still needs to approve it before it goes out.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "made with zero waste from farm to cup", "type": "green_claim"}], "publish": false}
```
